summary: Add an Examples section to the generated feedback command.
reason: The generated feedback command ships with no Example, so `dogfood --live` fails its help probe with 'missing Examples section'. The gap is in the framework template rather than this API, so every printed CLI is affected; this is a local stopgap pending a generator fix.
validated_outcome: feedback help probe passes; `teslatracker-pp-cli feedback --help` renders the Examples block.
